subject: Numbers polish: 15m commit huddle & evidence pass
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, james.lewis@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Numbers polish: 15m commit huddle & evidence pass

Team —

Quick midweek nudge: I want to run a tight 15-minute huddle today at 2:30pm PT to finalize commit signals for deals in the late-stage lane and confirm evidence slots. Goal: a clean set of accounts we can push to commit review tomorrow morning.

Agenda (15 minutes):
- 2:30–2:34: Rollup & quick gaps (I’ll share screen)
- 2:34–2:40: Account-by-account flags (Marcus / Laura quick 30s each)
- 2:40–2:43: Evidence confirmation and owners (Kimberly)
- 2:43–2:45: Final adjustments + confirm commit list

Please do two things before the huddle:
1) Update the attached commit-evidence.csv with the evidence you own (column: evidence_owner + link).
2) Flag any account that needs procurement lead time (external ask) in the Acme row — James, if procurement timeline changed, let us know in-thread.

I attached a sanitized rollup (acme-account-rollup.xlsx) and a short lane notes PDF.

If 2:30pm PT absolutely doesn't work, reply with 1 alternate 15-min window today; otherwise we’ll run on the time above and record decisions.

Thanks —
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0108

Attachments: commit-evidence.csv (spreadsheet stub), acme-account-rollup.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), lane-notes.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks Aditya — I’m in for 2:30. Quick notes:
- I updated the commit-evidence.csv: ACME-Portal screenshots + SOC2 export are owned by me (rows 7–9).
- Marcus: I left a short note in the spreadsheet where we still need legal confirmation on terms.
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether we have the audit log export available by EOD? That’s the last evidence item for Acme.

If procurement needs more lead time, suggest we mark Acme as "soft-commit" and exclude from final commit list until they confirm DocuSign window.

Laura

- Acme status: soft-commit. Laura confirmed screenshots + SOC2 export; Kimberly confirmed audit export will arrive by EOD.
